scope: One cold control/candidate pair for K1 case25 with full intermediate capture. A scoped source comparison, not a new expected baseline.

cuda_source_identity.copy_method: copyfile after candidate checkout; distinct read-only file and parent for each run

runs.name: 00_cold_control
runs.oracle_version: historical RELION5.0.1-d476e6 recorded in optimiser; not newly executed

stages.name: gpu_provenance
command:
import pathlib,os,json,recovar,jax
from recovar import cuda_backproject as cb
from recovar.relion_bind import _relion_bind_core as bind
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
assert pathlib.Path(recovar.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(repo)
assert pathlib.Path(jax.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(repo/'.pixi/envs/default')
assert len(jax.devices())==1 and jax.devices()[0].platform=='gpu'
assert jax.devices('cpu')
assert cb.cuda_available(),cb.cuda_unavailable_error()
assert pathlib.Path(cb._loaded_lib_path).resolve()==pathlib.Path(os.environ['RECOVAR_CUDA_LIB']).resolve()
assert pathlib.Path(bind.__file__).resolve().parent==pathlib.Path(os.environ['RECOVAR_RELION_BIND_BUILD_DIR']).resolve()
print(json.dumps({'recovar':recovar.__file__,'jax':jax.__file__,'jax_version':jax.__version__,'devices':[str(d) for d in jax.devices()],'cuda_library':str(cb._loaded_lib_path),'binding_library':bind.__file__}))

stages.name: refinement
stages.memory_method: sampled parent+descendant RSS and NVML compute-process bytes; raw rows retained
